text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH 5xx error rate detected on inference-gateway-usw2 (threshold breach). service: inference-gateway; metric: http_5xx_rate; window: 1m; value: 4.8% :rotating_light:
emily: acked. I'm on it, grabbing runbook + logs.
raj: i'm seeing the spike too, looks like most 502/504s originating from route /v1/generate - maybe a client flood.
tayla: linking runbook: https://runbooks/internal/inference/5xx-spike. start with checking node metrics + recent deploys.
emily: no recent deploys ~ 2h, but autoscaler scaled up 3 nodes around the start.
raj: throwing a quick query to logs to see request patterns:
raj: ```
# last 2m top client ids for /v1/generate
select client_id, count(*) from requests where path='/v1/generate' and status >=500 and timestamp > now()-2m group by client_id order by count desc limit 10;
# results: client_42: 5120, client_17: 80, client_8: 12
```
emily: client_42 is a large enterprise partner, had a bursty job earlier. can we gate that client?
tayla: can patch routing to weight down client's route or apply circuit-breaker. small change: add header-based rate-limit on edge for client_42.
sre_shift_lead: if we can do an edge rule quickly, do it. fallback: route traffic for client_42 to a degraded model (smaller) to reduce backend pressure.
raj: preparing a temporary edge rule now. curl to edge-api admin: ```curl -X POST https://edge-admin.usw2/rewrite -d '{"match": {"header.client":"client_42"}, "action": {"rate_limit": 200}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $EDGE_TOKEN'```
emily: please run it in dry-run first then commit.
raj: applied dry-run, saw simulated drop in QPS. committing now. :zap:
incidentbot: edge-admin: rule commit succeeded (rule-id: r-8731).
raj: monitoring backend 5xx after rule in effect. I see immediate drop in 5xx from 4.8% -> 1.1% within 30s.
tayla: nice. can we also temporarily increase backend replicas to absorb residual load?
sre_shift_lead: yes, scale set to +2 for inference-workers in usw2: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-workers --replicas=10 -n prod-usw2`
emily: running that now.
raj: logs still show a handful of stack traces from transformer-serving: `kv cache lookup failed: OOM` on a couple of pods — maybe the client burst caused KV cache pressure. opening a ticket for memory tuning.
emily: good call. ticket: https://tickets/inc/INC-2741 created. assign to eng-runtime.
tayla: any customer impact? support: check top 5 customers who've hit errors.
emily: support pinged, only client_42 reported increased latency & failures (they're aware), small number of other customers had transient failures but no major SLA breaches.
sre_shift_lead: keep watch for 15m, if 5xx < 0.5% for 10m we can demote the edge rule to dry-run and then remove.
raj: current 5xx rate 0.35% over 1m window.
incidentbot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by emily at 1779998890.
emily: closing pager for now, we'll keep the edge rule in place for 1h and follow up in eng-runtime meeting. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
raj: postmortem action items: add token-bucket caps per client, KV cache memory thresholds + alert, and playbook item for gating noisy clients. I'll draft.
tayla: adding follow-up to oncall checklist.
sre_shift_lead: nice triage, reassigning to eng-runtime for root cause and long-term mitigation.
incidentbot: Page resolved: condition cleared, final 1m 5xx rate 0.12%.
emily: logged summary in #incidents-summary and notified stakeholders. closing thread.
